product_summary: KASproc Technologies (Thane West, Maharashtra, B-614 Lodha Supremus, Kolshet Road; sales@kasproc.com) is an engineering-procurement integrator and supplier for beverage/dairy/edible-oil/spirits bottling plants. Real product lines published on kasproc.com: (1) complete packaging lines — bottling, blowing (Blowmatic, Combimatic integrated blow-fill-cap), filling (Flowmatic, Megastil, Megablock, Megahot, Mass, Megacell), labeling (Megaroll C/L, Selfie R/L), palletizing/depalletizing (Aspendos, Megapal, Megapal Robo), carton packing (Artemis, Bergama), conveyors; (2) process equipment — Combimix, Megamix, Megapas, syrup rooms, 5G gallon, Junior 300, VICTORIA5G; (3) capex procurement catalogue — water treatment plants, turnkey lab equipment, industrial LED lights, lightning & earthing materials, industrial valves & fittings, cables/cable accessories/cable ties/electrical installation accessories, conveyors, SS tanks, stainless steel pipes & fittings. Valves page explicitly lists ball, butterfly, gate, check, knife-gate, plug valves and strainers. Technology partners named: R. Bardi s.r.l. (Italy), Ektam (Turkey) — i.e. reseller/integrator of foreign OEM machinery.
role_hint: trader / integrator (solution integrator, capex procurement and sourcing agent; explicitly 'premium supplier' of valves and fittings, not a manufacturer; no own plant or production capability stated on site). Legal entity claimed as 'J D INDUSTRIES' does not appear anywhere on kasproc.com — the site consistently brands itself 'KASproc Technologies' / 'KASproc'. Name/entity mismatch between declaration and website is unresolved and should be flagged to the registry team.
comment: HS comparison: 848180 — exact match, corroborated by the dedicated Industrial Valves and Fittings page (ball/butterfly/gate/check/knife-gate/plug valves, strainers). 850440 — not corroborated: no static converter / UPS / power-supply product line appears on the site; the electrical range is limited to cables, cable accessories, cable ties, installation accessories, LED lights and earthing materials, which fall under 8544/8536/9405, not 8504. Marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 841370 — partial/weak: pumps are not a listed product line; centrifugal pumps would only appear as components inside water treatment plants and process equipment, so the code is plausible but not evidenced by any product page — 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. 732690 — not corroborated: no page describes miscellaneous steel articles; the closest real steel lines are SS tanks (7309) and SS pipes & fittings (7307), which are different headings. Marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Industry misclassification: declared as 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) — this is wrong. The company is a packaging/bottling-machinery integrator and industrial capex procurement house serving beverage, dairy, edible oil, spirits, cosmetics, pharma and cement; it is not a metallurgical or mining supplier. Correct industry should be industrial machinery / packaging equipment / engineering procurement. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: the core business — bottling, filling, blow-moulding, labeling, palletizing and carton-packing machinery (8422), process equipment and syrup rooms (8479), conveyors (8428), SS tanks (7309), SS pipes & fittings (7307), cables and electrical accessories (8544/8536), LED lighting (9405), water treatment plants (8421). Trader signs: the site self-describes as 'Solution Integrators', 'Consultants', 'single source provider', offers 'Product Selection & Sourcing', 'Consolidation of products from Different Manufacturers', 'International trade', and names foreign technology partners (R. Bardi s.r.l., Ektam) — clear reseller/integrator profile, not a manufacturer. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, codes corrected to the actual product range above. No customs line, shipping bill or B-L was reviewed in this pass (out of scope for this role), therefore every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level — the website evidences a catalogue, not dispatches.
